2608.12307.title: AI4AI at Test-Time: Strong-to-Weak Capability Transfer via Harnesses
2608.12307.paper_summary: Recent work on distillation transfers the capabilities of large models to smaller ones often by updating the latter's parameters, through teacher forcing, on-policy distillation, and related training-time methods. In this paper, we ask whether such transfer can instead occur at test time. We study strong-to-weak scaffolding: whether a stronger builder model can construct inference-time harnesses that help a weaker target model solve tasks more reliably without any parameter updates. Using four representative Theory-of-Mind benchmarks, each builder model uses 5% of the data as a validation set to iteratively refine its harness over multiple rounds, after which the finalized harness is evaluated on the full test set. Empirically, this form of test-time capability transfer is highly effective, nearly doubling average target-model performance from 0.49 to 0.91. Our analysis shows that the gains come primarily from offloading unstable model reasoning into deterministic code, benchmark-specific routing, and strict answer-format enforcement, rather than from encouraging the target model to reason more extensively or sample more broadly. We further find that builder-model reasoning effort improves harness quality monotonically, platform effects are modest relative to the builder model's own capability, and weaker target models receive the largest gains. These results suggest that inference-time harness design is an important complement to conventional training-time distillation, enabling strong models to transfer cognitive structure to weaker models without retraining.
2608.12307.paper_summary_zh: 最近的蒸餾工作將大型模型的能力轉移到較小的模型，通常是通過更新後者的參數，通過教師強迫、在線蒸餾和相關的訓練時間方法。<lb/>在本文中，我們探討這種轉移是否可以在測試時發生。<lb/>我們研究強到弱的支架：是否一個更強的建造者模型可以構建推理時的支架，幫助一個較弱的目標模型更可靠地解決任務，而無需任何參數更新。<lb/>使用四個代表性的心智理論基準，每個建造者模型使用5%的數據作為驗證集，通過多輪迭代來精煉其支架，之後對最終的支架在完整的測試集上進行評估。<lb/>實證表明，這種測試時能力轉移的形式非常有效，幾乎將目標模型的平均性能從0.49翻倍至0.91。<lb/>我們的分析顯示，這些增益主要來自於將不穩定的模型推理轉移到確定性代碼中、基準特定的路由和嚴格的答案格式執行，而不是鼓勵目標模型進行更廣泛的推理或更廣泛的取樣。<lb/>我們進一步發現，建造者模型的推理努力單調改善支架質量，平台效應相對於建造者模型自身的能力是適度的，而較弱的目標模型獲得了最大的增益。<lb/>這些結果表明，推理時的支架設計是傳統訓練時蒸餾的重要補充，使強大的模型能夠在不重新訓練的情況下將認知結構轉移到較弱的模型。
